again.description: Read a crawl again although it was read before.

check.description: Check at most this many unchecked boards against their ATS, oldest found first; default all, 0 checks none.

crawl.description: A Common Crawl crawl id such as `CC-MAIN-2026-43`; default the newest.

from.description: Where to look for company boards: `commoncrawl` (Common Crawl's URL index), or a file of board URLs or ids (`ashby:<slug>`), one per line.
